name: Convince Me!
description: Practice persuasive speaking by convincing classmates on random debate topics

intro.message:
Welcome to Convince Me!

You'll each get a random debate topic and two minutes to WRITE your most persuasive argument. Then each argument goes up on the screen — read it aloud to the class if you're up for it! — and everyone rates how well it lands.

Be creative, confident, and persuasive!

get-topics.instruction: Generate fun, age-appropriate debate topics for 15-year-olds. Mix silly and serious. Examples: 'Pizza should be classified as a sandwich', 'Schools should start at noon', 'Cats are better than dogs', 'Everyone should learn to juggle', 'Summer is overrated'. Make each topic different and engaging for teens.

assign-topics.message:
Topics assigned! Check your device to see what you'll be arguing.

You have two minutes to write your most persuasive argument.

Ready? Let's go!

prep-done.message:
Time's up! Arguments are in.

Each argument goes up on the screen — authors, read yours aloud if you want the full effect. Then everyone rates how well it landed.

Let's start!

intro-speaker.message:
Up next: {{_current.playerName}}!

Get ready to be convinced...

show-speech.message:
{{_current.playerName}} argues:

"{{_current.text}}"

{{_current.playerName}} — read it aloud if you're up for it! Then we rate.

conclusion.message:
Great persuasive speaking, everyone!

Remember: The most convincing speakers use specific examples, confident language, and connect with their audience.

Keep practicing!
